The target symbol is a pair of angled wall-wash/spot fixtures with hatched shades. In the drawing, these appear as small black paired symbols at the exterior walls.

The pairs I found are:
- (1413, 196): the pair on the right wall near the top.
- (71, 546): the pair on the left wall.
- (1160, 653): the pair near the lower right area.
- (1365, 815): the pair at the bottom right.
- (1087, 822): a pair near the bottom, at the freezer/cooler area.

The pair at (1413, 196) shows two small shapes at about (1413, 188) and (1413, 204), so I counted it as one pair. The pair at (71, 546) is similar, at about (71, 537) and (71, 553). The pair at (1160, 653) is at about (1150, 653) and (1168, 657). The pair at (1365, 815) is at about (1358, 815) and (1373, 815). For (1087, 822), I am less certain, because the circle-X symbol there may be a different fixture. I counted it as a pair anyway.
